constructor_behavior: ADD and MUL copied constructors duplicate the first operand type and shape; in-place constructors view the first operand. Neither constructor swaps operands.
Both constructors require ggml_can_repeat(second, first). Other operations and quantized ADD have separately specified source paths and are not established by the seven scalar tuples.
cpu_semantics: Decode each operand through its type_conversion_table to F32; perform one F32 arithmetic operation; encode to destination type after that operation. Preserve intermediate graph storage rounding; do not fuse the composed graph.
Require repeated right shape and equal left/output shapes; left and output inner strides equal their own type widths. Right inner stride may be noncontiguous.
Contiguous-row selection is right.n0 == 1 OR right.nb0 == right.typeSize. The width-one case ignores a nonstandard right inner stride.
On the contiguous-row path, the C++ int column counter spans right.n0, while the repeat counter spans left.n0/right.n0 using int64_t. Bound right.n0, not automatically left.n0.
On the noncontiguous-row path, the C++ int column counter spans left.n0; the int right-column index is column % right.n0.
Row and repeat counters are int64_t; do not introduce a 65536-row or INT32_MAX total-width cap where the authoritative loop does not have one.
implementation_sequence: Audit the existing F32 binary path too. Route ADD SUB MUL DIV through the same typed planner because the legacy path lacks the imported unit-inner-stride, alias and signed-counter guards.
Use separate bounded Prism roots for shared typed arithmetic planning and instruction generation; avoid growing the nearly full Pointwise certificate or adding a new mode variant.

Model all seven tuples, broadcasting, per-operand byte widths, exact conversions, signed counter bounds, empty tensors and safe alias/occupancy behavior. Decode and encode only when a type conversion is needed: F32 uses one phase, equal small storage uses four, mixed small/F32-to-small uses three, and mixed small/F32-to-F32 uses two. All numerical primitives remain imported Verdant calls.

Use shared operand/target/operation transport; bind right shape/strides once per graph operation, never validate metadata per element. Recover native source lines through shared transport before adding family-specific plumbing.

Run the 187-case imported composed test once after the changed root is certified. Generate targeted independent CPU supplemental fixtures in Prism for seven tuples and the boundaries not covered by factory construction.
Plant type/rounding/broadcast/alias/certificate defects, restore each source, and rerun only the affected cheapest gate. Run exact-SDK just vv at coherent capability acceptance.
acceptance_limits: The registered initial 187-case test genuinely failed at BF16/F32 arithmetic. Its unified typed implementation is in progress and has not yet completed the independent comparison.
RoPE compositions require their own implementation and factory coverage.
VT-02 production dependencies and original source-ceiling recovery remain mandatory.
